verdict.rationale: Extend documents an Extraction Schema with custom field types (date, currency, signature). Its Extract API takes a config, and every run returns the values the schema defined, with per-field confidence scores and citations. A long-term customer independently reports being happy with extraction accuracy. missing for 10: explicit documentation that the schema is standard JSON Schema and that outputs are validated against it, and hands-on corroboration of schema-conformant output.

support.subject: As a developer, I supply a JSON schema and get back validated structured fields extracted from the document

citations.quote: Every run gives you the values your schema defined, plus per-field confidence scores and citations that point back to the exact spot on the
Custom Field Types · Date Schema · Currency Schema · Signature Schema
The Extract API accepts a `config` object that controls how documents are processed and how values are returned.
